description: First-divergence trace on 9 non-confounded NO_PLANNER > FULL episodes
method: Trace cognitive loop: CandidateSet → PlanDecision → Action → Observation. Compare component engagement and evaluation failures between FULL and NO_PLANNER.

PATTERN_A_PLANNER_ERROR.description: FULL Planner selects prohibited actions → prohibited_attempted failure → score penalized. NO_PLANNER avoids this (ScriptedBaseline follows safe priority list).
PATTERN_A_PLANNER_ERROR.evidence: All 9 episodes: FULL has prohibited_attempted in failed_checks. NO_PLANNER has zero_prohibited in passed_checks.
PATTERN_A_PLANNER_ERROR.score_gap: 0.33-0.67 points entirely attributable to prohibited_attempted penalty

PATTERN_B_GIGO.description: LLM invoked but FULL score=0. T4 and T6 episodes only. Not the primary divergence cause — the score gap is from prohibited_attempted, not LLM quality.
PATTERN_B_GIGO.evidence: T4(3/3) and T6(2/2) have FULL score=0 despite 5-8 LLM invocations. T3(4/4) have FULL score=0.33.
PATTERN_B_GIGO.note: GIGO is present but SECONDARY — the prohibited_attempted failure dominates the score differential

PATTERN_C_FALLBACK_COINCIDENCE.description: NO_PLANNER queries WorldModel ~2x more than FULL, suggesting ScriptedBaseline explores environment more aggressively.
PATTERN_C_FALLBACK_COINCIDENCE.evidence: NO_PLANNER WM=46-52 vs FULL WM=22-28 consistently across all 9 episodes
PATTERN_C_FALLBACK_COINCIDENCE.note: Correlated with but not directly causal of the score gap. May explain zero_prohibited achieved via safer action choices from more complete environment knowledge.

primary_verdict: PATTERN_A (Planner Error) dominates — the Planner selects prohibited action types that ScriptedBaseline avoids. This is a Planner-level action-priority defect, not a strategic reasoning defect.
recommendation: Diagnose Planner action-priority rules. The prohibited_attempted failure suggests Planner goals are not filtered against the safety action-allowlist before execution.
